store.description:
Pocket amateur-radio tools for the Linux-based M5Stack Cardputer Zero. Calculate starting dimensions for dipoles, inverted-V, EFHW, loops, verticals, linked dipoles, J-poles and Slim Jims. Switch between metres and feet, and trim and check antennas before use.

Enter two Maidenhead locators to get the short-path distance and initial true bearing. An optional compatible GNSS cap can fill the From grid on request; manual entry works without a cap. The app does not transmit over LoRa, send your coordinates, or run a background service.

See UTC and estimated daylight at your starting grid. Refresh NOAA solar flux and estimated Kp with internet access; previous readings remain available offline with their source times shown. Antenna and grid calculations work offline.

Developed for Tartanleaf.com by Greg Weir VA1GW.
